documents.title: Sample AI Policy Language
documents.quality_note: University TLC syllabus templates for AI prohibited / permitted / required, with citation format and tie to the K-State Honor Pledge. Model language for instructors rather than a binding university rule.

documents.title: Using Generative AI with University Owned Records and Data Policy
documents.date_or_term: current (accessed 2026-10-25); date not stated in extracted text
documents.quality_note: Substantive rules on entering protected information and university records into GenAI, aimed at employees and records handling rather than coursework. It is an unnumbered draft ('Chapter ????', 'Created ??/??/????') and its file name ends in '- Copy', so it is probably not yet adopted; it applies to employees and contractors, not students.

documents.title: Artificial Intelligence (Responsible Use of Generative AI Task Force)
documents.quality_note: Describes the task force charge and focus areas (academic integrity, data, procurement, AI literacy). It states no student-facing rules; the framework is still being developed.

notes: No K-State-wide student AI rule was found beyond the Honor Pledge language quoted in the TLC sample statements (using AI to generate content without attribution violates the Honor Pledge); the university task force is still developing policy. The Honor Pledge page (https://www.k-state.edu/honor/basics/pledge.html) was not fetched separately. The CS department policies page (cs.ksu.edu/about/Policies) lists only buyout, tuition, travel and tenure policies, with no AI policy; no Carl R. Ice College of Engineering AI policy was found. The only known URL (CIS 598 textbook syllabus) is a course document and is deferred.
